diagnosis.bottleneck: The query spends most of its time scanning the promotion table and applying the filter p_channel_tv = 'N'. Even though the scan pushes down the filter, the column is not a partition key, so many row groups may be read if statistics are missing or if the predicate selectivity is high (i.e., a large fraction of rows match 'N').
